name: mcp-scryfall
description: Live Magic: The Gathering card lookup via the Scryfall API.
long_description: LLMs misremember card names, costs, and rules text. This server looks them up on live Scryfall instead: exact and fuzzy name lookup, query-syntax search, batch decklist resolution with an explicit not_found list, official rulings, and the bulk-data endpoint list. Read-only — it never writes anything to Scryfall or anywhere else.

tools.name: card_named
tools.description: Exact-name lookup of a Magic card.

tools.name: card_fuzzy
tools.description: Fuzzy-name lookup; handles typos and partial names.

tools.name: card_search
tools.description: Scryfall query-syntax search, compact summaries by default.

tools.name: card_collection
tools.description: Batch lookup of many cards in one call, with an explicit not_found list.

tools.name: card_random
tools.description: A random card, optionally filtered by a query.

tools.name: card_rulings
tools.description: Official Wizards rulings for one card.

scryfall_contact.title: Contact (optional)
scryfall_contact.description: An email or URL added to the User-Agent, which Scryfall's API guidelines ask clients to send so they can reach you about traffic. Not a credential, and nothing is sent to anyone but Scryfall. Leave blank to use this project's repository URL.
